input.question: Who is the artist of the album "Golden Hits"?

documents.text: The Golden Hits of Sandie Shaw The Golden Hits of Sandie Shaw is a compilation album by the British singer Sandie Shaw. Released in April 1966 by Pye Records on their budget Golden Guinea label, it contains all of the "A" sides and "B" sides of all her UK chart singles from 1964 to the end of 1965, which was technically all of her singles apart from her first which had failed to make an impression on the chart. source_segments.text: The Golden Hits of Sandie Shaw The Golden Hits of Sandie Shaw is a compilation album by the British singer Sandie Shaw.

Released in April 1966 by Pye Records on their budget Golden Guinea label, it contains all of the "A" sides and "B" sides of all her UK chart singles from 1964 to the end of 1965, which was technically all of her singles apart from her first which had failed to make an impression on the chart.
The "Golden Hits" compilation did not enter the UK Albums Chart.
This album has never been released on CD.
